query:
SELECT ref, name, user, created, public, allow_changes, cant_delete, keywords, savedsearch, home_page_publish, home_page_text, home_page_image, session_id, description, type, parent, thumbnail_selection_method, bg_img_resource_ref, order_by, username, fullname, count
                FROM (
                         SELECT c.ref, c.name, c.user, c.created, c.public, c.allow_changes, c.cant_delete, c.keywords, c.savedsearch, c.home_page_publish, c.home_page_text, c.home_page_image, c.session_id, c.description, c.type, c.parent, c.thumbnail_selection_method, c.bg_img_resource_ref, c.order_by, u.username, u.fullname, count(r.resource) AS count
                           FROM user AS u
                           JOIN collection AS c ON u.ref = c.user AND c.user = ?
                LEFT OUTER JOIN collection_resource AS r ON c.ref = r.collection
                       WHERE c.`type` IN (?,?,?) 
                       
                       GROUP BY c.ref
        
                          UNION
                         SELECT c.ref, c.name, c.user, c.created, c.public, c.allow_changes, c.cant_delete, c.keywords, c.savedsearch, c.home_page_publish, c.home_page_text, c.home_page_image, c.session_id, c.description, c.type, c.parent, c.thumbnail_selection_method, c.bg_img_resource_ref, c.order_by, u.username, u.fullname, count(r.resource) AS count
                           FROM user_collection AS uc
                           JOIN collection AS c ON uc.collection = c.ref AND uc.user = ? AND c.user <> ?
                LEFT OUTER JOIN collection_resource AS r ON c.ref = r.collection
                      LEFT JOIN user AS u ON c.user = u.ref
                       WHERE c.`type` IN (?,?,?)
                       GROUP BY c.ref
        
                          UNION
                         SELECT c.ref, c.name, c.user, c.created, c.public, c.allow_changes, c.cant_delete, c.keywords, c.savedsearch, c.home_page_publish, c.home_page_text, c.home_page_image, c.session_id, c.description, c.type, c.parent, c.thumbnail_selection_method, c.bg_img_resource_ref, c.order_by, u.username, u.fullname, count(r.resource) AS count
                           FROM usergroup_collection AS gc
                           JOIN collection AS c ON gc.collection = c.ref AND gc.usergroup = ? AND c.user <> ?
                LEFT OUTER JOIN collection_resource AS r ON c.ref = r.collection
                      LEFT JOIN user AS u ON c.user = u.ref
                       WHERE c.`type` IN (?,?,?)
                        GROUP BY c.ref
        ) AS clist
        
        GROUP BY ref
